correctness.rationale: The exact coefficient action on orthonormal monomials determines two residue classes modulo the square of the slant order. Gamma-moment ratios tend respectively to s^(alpha+1) and 1, giving explicit compact equivalence of the two products to partial shifts. Distinct residues force CC* to be the scalar 2c^2 modulo compacts; equal residues and different output shifts give c^2(2-U^d-U^-d) with spectrum [0,4c^2]. Infinite inactive input residue classes give 0 in the essential absolute-value spectrum. All parameters and zero cases are explicitly covered. The standalone script passed 184712 finite consistency checks; it is not the proof.
